items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I had Big Eye Louie, Rodgers.

ctx.x: And who'd you have down there?

I had Big Eye Louie, Rodgers. You had Lucian in four a while too. I had Lucian, we had Lucian on drums but I mean. I left Rodgers, Big Eye Louie. And, uh, well I left, I turned the job over to Rodgers. See, but Louie was working there, see. So Rodgers just looked around and got the other piano player. But I think, what was his name, Octavia? Octave. Octave. Not Octave in there.
You might be talking to him, he played up in the chorus too. Yeah.

items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: Yeah, he worked with us. Yeah, he worked with us.

ctx.x: Yeah, I went there a while with us.
See, now I went away. Yeah, he worked with us. Yeah, he worked with us.
You know, you had a job at Lutches? Yeah, see I had a job already at Lutches.
